title: Yellow Crunchy Thai Shrimp Tom Yum
description: A resinous and crunchy Thai dish featuring shrimp in a spicy tom yum broth with red wine jelly, perfect for a brunch mood, this central Thai inspired recipe is low fat friendly and full of flavor.
instructions: Heat the coconut milk in a large pot over medium heat until it starts to simmer.
Add the tom yum paste and stir until it is fully incorporated.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar, and stir until the sugar is dissolved.
Add the shrimp and cook until they are pink and fully cooked.
Stir in the red wine jelly until it is fully incorporated.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the tom yum hot, garnished with crushed peanuts.
Offer steamed rice or noodles on the side.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or basil for added flavor and color.
